name: trosmos-os
description: Trosmos OS 4.1 — full-stack AI-native web operating system. Real multi-user backend (Node.js + SQLite), secure VFS, auth, WebSockets, AI tools, window manager, terminal, and honest browser-capability boundaries.

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n server,web -c blue,magenta "npm run server:dev" "npm run web:dev"
scripts.db:reset: rm -f server/data/trosmos.db server/data/trosmos.db-* && echo Database reset. Restart the server to recreate schema.
